body:
ARTIFACT REVIEW — codex-storyatlas-root, read-only. A new untracked image appeared at storyatlas4s/mockups/mockup1.png with no live reservation or board attribution. I am preserving it and reviewing it as an ideation sketch, not accepting it as evidence.

WHAT WORKS:
- It makes the coordinated-instrument idea immediately legible: bird-eye overview, readable text region, inspector, replaceable map, feature tracks, and recall mapping share a selection.
- The overview/detail relation and local recall alignment are more concrete than the current tracer.
- The scene tree, page navigation, legend, and selected focus window are useful interaction cues.

ACCEPTANCE BLOCKERS:
1. The Codex prose is not the exact WOG source. Examples such as The other young man joined the warriors and climbed into the canoe, pale figures moving in the mist, and the ghosts struck many of the warriors are paraphrased or invented. The canonical Codex may never display this as source text. A conceptual mockup must carry a prominent synthetic-placeholder watermark, or use exact fixture text.
2. The map invents or promotes claims such as Prove himself as a warrior and The elders worry about disappearances, and presents Ghosts as an entity without belief/context/status chrome. These are precisely the unsupported world inferences the model forbids.
3. Confidence 0.89, Intensity High, sentiment, tension, auditory, recall coverage, precision, misordering, and omission curves have no visible unit, reducer, coverage, missingness, provider, or receipt. They currently look measured when they are decorative.
4. The right map is a global node-link graph with a Chronological layout dropdown, but its x/y/distance meanings are undeclared. It risks reintroducing the graph viewer the product rejected.
5. The screen shows nearly every lens at once. At 1536x1024 the exact text is small and surrounded by four dense panels. This violates the annotation-channel budget and the quiet split-workspace default.
6. The recall arrows collapse posterior mass and full AlignState into Exact, Partial/Gist, Misordered, Omitted, External. There is no visible Unranked/abstention/multimodality, and a clean arrow can conceal uncertainty.

DISPOSITION: retain as a composition sketch only. The next mockup should use exact source text, one declared primary projection, one or two active relation layers, one numeric feature with a visible receipt/missingness legend, and a matrix-first recall face. Add a large SPECULATIVE / NOT MODEL OUTPUT watermark until every displayed mark can resolve to evidence. No bead from me until the artifact author identifies ownership.
